cues.en: Hopefully you managed to get that running, but if you're new to Python it may have been a little bit challenging.
cues.zh: 希望你已經成功執行了。不過如果你是 Python 新手，可能會覺得有點挑戰。

cues.en: If you'd like to look at my solution, open up Spyder and close out everything you no longer want to look at with Control + Shift + W.
cues.zh: 如果想看我的解答，開啟 Spyder，按 Ctrl + Shift + W，關閉所有不再需要看的檔案。

cues.en: Now open up everything in the Challenges folder of the course materials.
cues.zh: 現在開啟課程教材 Challenges 資料夾中的所有檔案。

cues.en: Select the EvaluateUserCF-Exploration file.
cues.zh: 選取 EvaluateUserCF-Exploration 檔案。

cues.en: There are only a few changes here, first, we're importing MovieLens2 instead of MovieLens, which is my modified MovieLens module that we'll look at shortly.
cues.zh: 這裡只有幾項修改。首先，匯入的是 MovieLens2，而非 MovieLens。它是我修改過的 MovieLens 模組，稍後會看。

cues.en: It's been modified to identify movies from the most recent year.
cues.zh: 我修改了它，讓它能找出最新年份的電影。

cues.en: If we skip down to line 41, we can see where I'm retrieving that list of new movies, and defining which slot in my top-10 recommendations will be used to surface those new
cues.zh: 跳到第 41 行，可以看到我在哪裡取得新電影清單，以及定義前十名推薦中的哪個位置，要用來隨機呈現這些新，

cues.en: movies at random.
cues.zh: 電影。

cues.en: Skipping down to line 78, this is where we are constructing the top-10 recommendations for each user.
cues.zh: 再跳到第 78 行，這裡是為每位使用者建構前十名推薦的地方。

cues.en: If we're in the final slot we defined, we choose one of those new movies at random, otherwise, we select the movie with the next-highest recommendation score for this user.
cues.zh: 如果來到指定的最後位置，就隨機選一部新電影；否則，選擇對這位使用者推薦分數次高的電影。

cues.en: There's more than one way to code this up, by the way.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，實作方式不只一種。

cues.en: An arguably better approach would be to just generate the top nine recommendations normally, and then tack on that random new movie at the end outside of this loop.
cues.zh: 可以說更好的做法，是先正常產生前九名推薦，再在迴圈外，將隨機的新電影附加到最後。

cues.en: That way we'd get that new movie even if we didn't have 10 recommendations to show for the user.
cues.zh: 如此一來，即使沒有十個推薦能顯示給使用者，也能得到那部新電影。

cues.en: Let's peek at my MovieLens2.py file.
cues.zh: 來看我的 MovieLens2.py 檔案。

cues.en: What's new here is the getNewMovies function, which isn't too bad.
cues.zh: 新增的是 getNewMovies 函式，其實並不難。

cues.en: We just use the max function to find the most recent year in our data.
cues.zh: 只要用 max 函式，找出資料中的最新年份。

cues.en: Then, we iterate through every movie, appending movies with a release date that matches that year to the newMovies list that we then return.
cues.zh: 接著逐一走訪每部電影，將上映年份相符的電影，附加到 newMovies 清單，再回傳它。

cues.en: Let's kick it off and see if it works.
cues.zh: 執行看看能不能運作。

cues.en: Go back to EvaluateUserCF-Exploration and hit play, and it will come back pretty quickly.
cues.zh: 回到 EvaluateUserCF-Exploration，按下執行，很快就會得到結果。

cues.en: We can see the most recent movie in this data set is from 2016, and recommending random movies from 2016 really didn't hurt our hit rate much, we're still at over 5%, which is pretty good.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這個資料集最新的電影來自 2016 年，而隨機推薦 2016 年電影，並沒有太影響命中率。我們仍超過 5%，相當不錯。

cues.en: With movies, new releases are usually of general interest, so it's arguably not a bad thing to recommend, and if you have an explicit goal of surfacing new items to users as soon as possible,
cues.zh: 對電影而言，新片通常大家都會有興趣，所以推薦新片可以說不差。如果你有明確目標，希望盡快讓新項目曝光給使用者，

cues.en: this is a reasonable way to do it.
cues.zh: 這就是合理的做法。
